origin: D-22a: surface that the Flutter plugin already exposes between its Dart layer and the native Android SDK; the React Native, Capacitor/Cordova/Ionic and .NET MAUI layers (D-22a..c) replicate this set and add no logic of their own
notes: Any other error code is the stable `code` of an SDK error (SentomaruError, EnrollmentError) forwarded as is.

A `bytes` value (sign.body in, sealedLoad out) crosses a text channel as canonical RFC 4648 section 4 Base64: standard alphabet, padding, no whitespace, no non-zero trailing bits. A reader refuses any other text as ChannelError, or IllegalArgumentException from the Kotlin adapters on the way in (shared sdk/hybrid-core CanonicalBase64; vectors: hybrid-bridge-v1-vectors.json, bytes and bytesRejected).
A hybrid layer adds no method, no default and no retry: a method missing here is a change of this contract first.
iOS of each layer only after the layer's Android gate (D-22, D-09/D-10 are done).
